name: UnSub (Load/Mine Hugging Face model-repository campaign) — Pluto Security
description: Pluto Security tracked 31 malicious Hugging Face model repositories across seven accounts (a first wave of 12, then a second wave of 19 across five accounts that followed within days of the takedown; a separate ModelScope account is listed outside that count) whose Python code runs on load when `trust_remote_code=True`, before any weights are used, installing watchdog/shell-profile persistence, SSH-key or reverse-shell backdoors, a fileless peakminer cryptominer disguised as a kernel worker, and a container-to-host escape script (success not confirmed); targets were self-hosted inference platforms (Xinference, GPUStack), rented GPU machines and notebooks. The first-wave wallet had received about 2,276 PRL across 716 transactions (Pluto's summary puts this near $5,000); 29,818 recorded downloads across the 31 repositories (downloads are not confirmed infections). *Analyst note: untrusted-tier vendor source, read at primary; real adversary operation with on-chain payout evidence.* Pluto Security
